provideStylesRows.name: MapStylesConfig
provideStylesRows.type: { light?: string | StyleSpecification; dark?: string | StyleSpecification }
provideStylesRows.description: Per-theme basemap. A theme left undefined falls back to the Carto default for that theme.

provideStylesRows.name: provideMapStyles(source)
provideStylesRows.description: Provider for the app-wide basemap. The factory form runs in an injection context, so it can inject() a service holding the signal.

provideStylesRows.name: MAP_DEFAULT_STYLES
provideStylesRows.description: The token itself, if you want to provide it by hand.

provideLabelsRows.name: MapLabels
provideLabelsRows.type: { zoomIn; zoomOut; resetNorth; locate; fullscreen; loading; closePopup; popup; marker; scale; legend; showLegend; hideLegend; mapStyle; minimap; showMinimap; hideMinimap; play; pause; playbackProgress; playbackSpeed: string }
provideLabelsRows.description: Every user-facing and aria string the library renders. Defaults are English: 'Zoom in', 'Zoom out', 'Reset north', 'My location', 'Toggle fullscreen', 'Loading map', 'Close popup', 'Map popup', 'Map marker', 'Map scale', 'Map legend', 'Show legend', 'Hide legend', 'Map style', 'Overview map', 'Show overview map', 'Hide overview map', 'Play', 'Pause', 'Playback progress', 'Playback speed'.

provideLabelsRows.name: provideMapLabels(source)
provideLabelsRows.description: Provider for app-wide labels; missing keys fall back to the English defaults. The factory form runs in an injection context, so it can inject() a service holding the signal.

provideLabelsRows.name: MAP_LABELS
provideLabelsRows.description: The token itself, if you want to provide it by hand.

contextRows.name: map()
contextRows.description: The raw maplibre-gl Map instance, or null before init.

contextRows.name: isLoaded()
contextRows.description: True when the style is loaded and layers can be added. Gates every source/layer operation; closes during a theme/basemap switch and re-opens once it settles (or fails).

contextRows.name: resolvedTheme()
contextRows.description: Theme currently applied to the map.

contextRows.name: currentStyle()
contextRows.description: Style last requested or applied by ng-map (URL or spec), null before the map exists. It is set before the swap finishes and kept when the change is a no-op diff or the fetch fails. ng-map-minimap mirrors it.

contextRows.name: hasSource(id)
contextRows.description: Whether a source component (raster, vector, image overlay) currently has a source with this id on the map. Reactive inside effect(); false while a theme switch has removed the style. Wait on it before adding layers that reference source: id.

contextRows.name: sourceIds()
contextRows.description: Ids of the sources currently announced by source components.

contextRows.name: registerSource(id)
contextRows.description: Announces a source you added yourself so hasSource(id) sees it; returns the release function to call when you remove it.

contextRows.name: fitBounds(options?)
contextRows.description: Fits the camera to options.bounds, or to the union of the children's data. Returns false when the map is not loaded or there are no bounds.

contextRows.name: dataBounds()
contextRows.description: Union of the bounds registered by the children, as [west, south, east, north].

contextRows.name: acquireImage(id, data, options)
contextRows.type: (id: string, data, options: { sdf: boolean; pixelRatio: number }) => () => void
contextRows.description: Takes a reference to a style image, adding it when the style has none under that id (the first user provides the pixels). Returns the release function: the image is removed with its last reference, and only if it is still the one added here. Release while the gate is closed and acquire again once it re-opens. Used by ng-map-symbol-layer.

contextRows.name: registerBounds(getter)
contextRows.description: Contributes a bounds source to fit-to-bounds. The getter runs reactively; returns the unregister function (call it on destroy).

sections.title: Map
sections.description: The root container component that initializes MapLibre GL and provides context to child components. Automatically handles theme switching between light and dark modes.

inputs.name: center
inputs.description: Initial center coordinates as [longitude, latitude].

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Initial zoom level of the map.

inputs.name: styles
inputs.description: Custom style URLs or style objects for light and dark themes.

inputs.name: blank
inputs.description: Swaps the basemap for a transparent, tile-less canvas. Add your own layers on top.

inputs.name: projection
inputs.description: Map projection, e.g. { type: 'globe' }.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Force a theme, or 'auto' to follow the dark/light class on <html>.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Shows the loading overlay.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (loading), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: viewport
inputs.description: Controlled viewport ({ center, zoom, bearing, pitch }). Pair with viewportChange.

inputs.name: fitBounds
inputs.description: Fits the camera to bounds ({ bounds?, padding?, maxZoom?, duration?, animate? }). Without bounds it fits the union of the children's data (markers, GeoJSON, routes, arcs, clusters, heatmaps). Runs after load and refits only when the bounds change; the first fit never animates; maxZoom defaults to 16. A draggable marker bound to signals refits while dragged: pass explicit bounds for that case. Imperative form: MapContextService.fitBounds().

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Extra MapLibre MapOptions (scrollZoom, dragRotate, …) passed to the map constructor.

outputs.name: viewportChange
outputs.description: Emits on every viewport change (move, zoom, rotate, pitch).

outputs.name: mapReady
outputs.description: Emits the raw maplibre-gl Map instance once loaded.

outputs.name: mapClick
outputs.description: Emits when the map is clicked.

outputs.name: mapError
outputs.description: Emits when the map fails to initialize or load.

sections.title: MapControls
sections.description: Renders map control buttons: zoom, compass, locate, and fullscreen. Mounted inside MapLibre's corner containers, so it stacks with the scale, legend and style switcher; style it with className. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the controls in.

inputs.name: showZoom
inputs.description: Show zoom in/out buttons.

inputs.name: showCompass
inputs.description: Show compass button (resets bearing).

inputs.name: showLocate
inputs.description: Show geolocate button.

inputs.name: showFullscreen
inputs.description: Show fullscreen toggle button.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (zoomIn, zoomOut, resetNorth, locate, fullscreen), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-controls element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

outputs.name: locateChange
outputs.description: Emits the user position after a successful locate.

outputs.name: locateError
outputs.description: Emits when locating fails (denied, timeout) or when the browser has no geolocation.

sections.title: MapScale
sections.description: A scale bar mounted as a MapLibre control in a corner of the map. It updates while the map moves or zooms, rounds to a 1/2/5 length and formats the value with Intl for the app locale. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: Unit system of the bar. 'both' draws a metric and an imperial bar.

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.description: Longest bar length in pixels.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the scale in.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (scale), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-scale element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

sections.title: MapLegend
sections.description: A legend card mounted as a MapLibre control. Describes data with category swatches and colour gradients; projected content renders below the sections. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: sections
inputs.description: Legend sections: { type: 'categories', title?, entries: { color, label, shape?: 'circle' | 'square' | 'line' }[] } or { type: 'gradient', title?, stops: { color, value }[], format?: (value) => string }. Gradients always label the first and last stop; middle stops are hidden when they would overlap a neighbour.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading of the legend; also its accessible name.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the legend in.

inputs.name: collapsible
inputs.description: Shows a header button that hides the legend body; its accessible name is the heading followed by the show/hide label (e.g. "Places, Hide legend").

inputs.name: collapsed
inputs.description: Whether the body is hidden. A model(): supports two-way binding with [(collapsed)].

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (legend, showLegend, hideLegend), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-legend element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

outputs.name: collapsedChange
outputs.description: Emits when the legend is collapsed or expanded (the model output of collapsed).

sections.title: MapStyleSwitcher
sections.description: A listbox in a map corner that switches the basemap between the given options. The selected option overrides provideMapStyles() and the map's [styles] for that map; with no value the map keeps its own style. Keep each option's styles object referentially stable: an inline object literal is a new style every render and re-runs setStyle. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Choices: { id: string; label: string; styles: MapStylesConfig }. Keep the array and each styles object referentially stable (declare them once, not inline in the template).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Id of the selected option. A model(): supports [(value)]. undefined leaves the map's own style untouched.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the switcher in.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (mapStyle), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-style-switcher element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: Emits the selected option id (the model output of value).

sections.title: MapMinimap
sections.description: An overview map mounted as a MapLibre control in a corner of the map (stacks with the other controls). A second map follows the main viewport at a lower zoom, draws the main viewport footprint (correct with bearing and pitch) and is always mercator and north-up. Clicking recenters the main map (easeTo), dragging pans it, and arrow keys pan it 100 px while the minimap is focused. It mirrors the main map's effective basemap (theme and style switcher) unless styles or blank is set. Collapsing destroys the minimap instance and frees its WebGL context. Renders nothing on the server. The minimap shows no attribution: a custom styles override's attribution is the app's responsibility. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the minimap in.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Width of the map area, in pixels.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Height of the map area, in pixels.

inputs.name: zoomOffset
inputs.description: The minimap zoom is max(main zoom - zoomOffset, 0).

inputs.name: styles
inputs.description: Own basemap, themed by the resolved theme. Wins over blank and over the main map's style.

inputs.name: blank
inputs.description: Uses the blank style; ignored when styles is set.

inputs.name: collapsed
inputs.description: Whether the overview map is collapsed. A model(): supports two-way binding with [(collapsed)]. Collapsing destroys the minimap instance.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (minimap, showMinimap, hideMinimap), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-minimap element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

outputs.name: collapsedChange
outputs.description: Emits when the minimap is collapsed or expanded (the model output of collapsed).

sections.title: MapMarker
sections.description: A container for marker-related components. Provides context for its children and handles marker positioning.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.description: Longitude coordinate of the marker.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.description: Latitude coordinate of the marker.

inputs.name: draggable
inputs.description: Allows the marker to be dragged.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Pixel offset applied to the marker element.

inputs.name: rotation
inputs.description: Rotation of the marker in degrees.

inputs.name: anchor
inputs.description: Part of the marker element positioned at the coordinates.

inputs.name: rotationAlignment
inputs.description: How the marker rotates with the map.

inputs.name: pitchAlignment
inputs.description: How the marker tilts with the map pitch.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the marker (aria-label). Interactive markers whose content has no text fall back to labels.marker ('Map marker'); a static labelled marker gets role="img".

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (marker), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: keyboardStep
inputs.description: Pixels a draggable marker moves per arrow key press.

inputs.name: keyboardStepLarge
inputs.description: Pixels per arrow key press while Shift is held.

outputs.name: markerClick
outputs.description: Emits when the marker is clicked, or when Enter or Space (on keyup) is pressed on the focused marker, also with ng-marker-popup. Give icon-only clickable markers their own ariaLabel. A marker with this handler becomes a role=button tab stop.

outputs.name: markerMouseEnter
outputs.description: Emits when the pointer enters the marker.

outputs.name: markerMouseLeave
outputs.description: Emits when the pointer leaves the marker.

outputs.name: dragStart
outputs.description: Emits when dragging starts.

outputs.name: drag
outputs.description: Emits continuously while dragging.

outputs.name: dragEnd
outputs.description: Emits the final position after dragging.

sections.title: MarkerContent
sections.description: Renders the visual content of a marker via content projection. If left empty, a default blue dot is rendered; it follows conditional content (shown while nothing is projected). Must be used inside ng-map-marker.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-marker-content element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

sections.title: MarkerLabel
sections.description: An always-visible text label above or below the marker. Must be used inside ng-marker-content.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Side of the marker the label appears on.

sections.title: MarkerPopup
sections.description: A popup attached to the marker that opens on click. Must be used inside ng-map-marker. Keyboard: the marker becomes a focusable role=button with aria-haspopup=dialog (unless you set them) and aria-expanded (true while its popup is open, whatever opened or closed it); while open, aria-controls names the popup card (.ng-popup-card, which gets a generated id). Enter/Space opens it, focus moves into the popup, and Escape closes it, stops propagation and returns focus to the marker. The card is a non-modal role=dialog (no aria-modal) named by aria-label: the popup's ariaLabel, else the marker's ariaLabel, else 'Map popup' (labels.popup). A marker whose content has its own button gets no role and no aria-expanded (that button is the keyboard target): mirror the state on it through a template reference, <ng-marker-popup #info> with aria-haspopup="dialog" [attr.aria-expanded]="info.isOpen()" [attr.aria-controls]="info.isOpen() ? info.cardId : null" on the button. Public members: isOpen (Signal<boolean>, in sync with every open and close) and cardId (the id of the .ng-popup-card, in the DOM only while open).

inputs.name: closeButton
inputs.description: Shows a close button in the popup.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Pixel offset from the marker. Reconciled live via setOffset; MapLibre's default when unset.

inputs.name: anchor
inputs.description: Which side of the marker the popup anchors to. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.description: CSS max-width of the popup container. Reconciled live via setMaxWidth.

inputs.name: closeOnClick
inputs.description: Closes the popup when the map is clicked. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the card, a non-modal role=dialog (aria-label; reactive). Falls back to the marker's ariaLabel, then to 'Map popup' (labels.popup).

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (closePopup, popup), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-popup-card element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

outputs.name: popupClose
outputs.description: Emits when the popup closes.

sections.title: MarkerTooltip
sections.description: A tooltip that appears on marker hover and keyboard focus (Escape or blur closes it; the marker becomes a tab stop). Must be used inside ng-map-marker.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Pixel distance between the marker and the tooltip.

inputs.name: anchor
inputs.description: Which side of the coordinates the tooltip anchors to.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-tooltip-pill element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

sections.title: MapPopup
sections.description: A standalone popup component that can be placed anywhere on the map without a marker. Must be used inside ng-map. Keyboard: focus moves into the popup when it opens, and Escape inside it closes it (stops propagation, so a host dialog stays open). The card is a non-modal role=dialog (no aria-modal) named by aria-label: ariaLabel, else 'Map popup' (labels.popup).

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.description: Longitude coordinate of the popup.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.description: Latitude coordinate of the popup.

inputs.name: closeButton
inputs.description: Shows a close button in the popup.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Pixel offset of the popup.

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.description: CSS max-width of the popup container.

inputs.name: closeOnClick
inputs.description: Closes the popup when the map is clicked. Applied at creation only. Set false for popups that follow the hover.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the card, a non-modal role=dialog (aria-label; reactive). Falls back to 'Map popup' (labels.popup).

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (closePopup, popup), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-popup-card element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept. Pass ng-popup-passthrough to make the whole popup non-interactive (pointer-events: none), so a hover popup does not capture the cursor and close itself.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Whether the popup is shown. Two-way bindable with [(open)]: closing it writes false, setting true opens it again at the current position.

outputs.name: popupClose
outputs.description: Emits when the popup closes, by the user or by setting open to false.

outputs.name: openChange
outputs.description: Emits the new open state (the [(open)] binding).

sections.title: MapRoute
sections.description: Renders a line/route from the given coordinates. Must be used inside ng-map. Supports click and hover interactions, an active (highlighted) state and a covered-progress line via child ng-route-progress / ng-route-marker components.

inputs.name: coordinates
inputs.description: Array of [longitude, latitude] points forming the line.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Line color.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Line width in pixels.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Line opacity.

inputs.name: dashArray
inputs.description: Dash pattern, e.g. [2, 2].

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Enables pointer events on the line.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Id of an existing layer to insert the route (and its progress line) below. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: progress
inputs.description: Covered fraction of the route (0 to 1). Drawn by a child ng-route-progress and followed by ng-route-marker at="progress".

inputs.name: active
inputs.description: Highlights the route: the active* inputs override the base paint while true.

inputs.name: activeColor
inputs.description: Line color while active. Falls back to color.

inputs.name: activeWidth
inputs.description: Line width while active. Falls back to width.

inputs.name: activeOpacity
inputs.description: Line opacity while active. Falls back to opacity.

inputs.name: activeDashArray
inputs.description: Dash pattern while active. Falls back to dashArray.

outputs.name: routeClick
outputs.description: Emits when the route is clicked.

outputs.name: routeMouseEnter
outputs.description: Emits when the pointer enters the route (the cursor becomes a pointer).

outputs.name: routeMouseLeave
outputs.description: Emits when the pointer leaves the route.

sections.title: RouteProgress
sections.description: Draws the covered part of the parent ng-map-route, as set by its progress input (computed by cumulative distance along the line). Use inside ng-map-route.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Color of the covered line.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Width of the covered line in pixels.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Opacity of the covered line.

inputs.name: dashArray
inputs.description: Dash pattern of the covered line.

sections.title: RouteMarker
sections.description: A marker placed along the parent ng-map-route. Project ng-marker-content (and label, popup, tooltip) into it. Created once and moved as progress or coordinates change.

inputs.name: at
inputs.description: Position on the route: its start, end, the current progress, or a fraction between 0 and 1 of the total distance.

sections.title: RoutePlayback
sections.description: Animates the parent ng-map-route over time. While present it overrides the route's progress input, so ng-route-progress and ng-route-marker at="progress" follow along. Control it through the playing/progress/speed bindings or the play(), pause(), toggle(), restart() and seek() methods on a template reference. The frame loop runs outside the Angular zone. Use inside ng-map-route.

inputs.name: playing
inputs.description: Whether the animation is running. A model(): supports [(playing)].

inputs.name: progress
inputs.description: Covered fraction of the route. The value applied to the route (and by seek()) is clamped to 0-1; the model keeps what you write. A model(): supports [(progress)].

inputs.name: speed
inputs.description: Playback rate multiplier. A model(): supports [(speed)].

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Milliseconds a full pass takes at speed 1.

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: Wrap to the start instead of stopping at the end.

inputs.name: follow
inputs.description: Center the camera on the playback head every frame and on seek(). A user drag suspends following until play() or restart() (or follow is turned off and on); it waits while the map is moving.

outputs.name: ended
outputs.description: Emits once when playback reaches the end (never when loop is on). Emitted inside the Angular zone.

outputs.name: playingChange
outputs.description: Emits the new playing state (the [(playing)] binding).

outputs.name: progressChange
outputs.description: Emits the new progress (the [(progress)] binding).

outputs.name: speedChange
outputs.description: Emits the new speed (the [(speed)] binding).

sections.title: RoutePlaybackControl
sections.description: Play/pause button, progress scrubber and speed selector for an ng-route-playback, mounted as a MapLibre control so it stacks with the other corner controls. Place it as a direct child of ng-map (not inside the route) and point for at the playback template reference.

inputs.name: for
inputs.description: The playback to drive, e.g. #pb on ng-route-playback.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Corner of the map to place the control in.

inputs.name: speeds
inputs.description: Speeds offered by the selector; the current speed is added when missing.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Label overrides (play, pause, playbackProgress, playbackSpeed), merged over provideMapLabels() and the English defaults.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra space-separated classes added to the rendered .ng-playback element. Reactive; the built-in class is always kept.

sections.title: MapArc
sections.description: Renders curved lines between coordinate pairs using quadratic Bézier interpolation, with longitude unwrapping across the antimeridian. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Arcs to draw: { id, from: [lng, lat], to: [lng, lat] }. Extra properties are exposed to paint expressions.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer.

inputs.name: curvature
inputs.description: How much the arc bends.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Number of interpolation points per arc.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: MapLibre line paint properties.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: MapLibre line layout properties.

inputs.name: hoverPaint
inputs.description: Paint overrides applied to the hovered arc via feature-state.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Enables pointer events (adds an invisible hit layer).

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id.

outputs.name: arcClick
outputs.description: Emits { arc, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } when an arc is clicked.

outputs.name: arcHover
outputs.description: Emits on hover; null when the pointer leaves.

sections.title: MapGeoJSON
sections.description:
Renders GeoJSON polygons and lines with theme-aware monochrome defaults and declarative feature-state hover. Accepts a URL or an inline GeoJSON object. Generic over the feature properties: MapGeoJSONComponent

, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: GeoJSON object or URL string. P types the featureClick/featureHover payloads.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id for the underlying source/layer.

inputs.name: promoteId
inputs.description: Feature property used as feature id — required for hover feature-state.

inputs.name: fillPaint
inputs.description: Fill paint properties.

inputs.name: linePaint
inputs.description: Outline paint properties.

inputs.name: fillHoverPaint
inputs.description: Fill paint overrides applied to the hovered feature.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Enables pointer events and hover tracking.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layers before this layer id.

outputs.name: featureClick
outputs.description: Emits { feature, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } on click.

outputs.name: featureHover
outputs.description: Emits on hover; null when the pointer leaves.

sections.title: MapClusterLayer
sections.description:
Renders clustered points with MapLibre GL native clustering. Automatically styles cluster circles by point count, zooms in on cluster click. Generic over the feature properties: MapClusterLayerComponent

, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: GeoJSON points (object or URL string). P types the pointClick payload.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id prefix for the source and layers: cluster-source-<id>, clusters-<id>, cluster-count-<id>, unclustered-point-<id>. Changing it re-creates them.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the cluster layers before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: clusterMaxZoom
inputs.description: Max zoom at which points are clustered.

inputs.name: clusterRadius
inputs.description: Cluster radius in pixels.

inputs.name: clusterColors
inputs.description: Circle colors for small/medium/large clusters. ng-mapcn defaults to green/yellow/red; mapcn uses ['#3b82f6', '#1d4ed8', '#1e3a8a'].

inputs.name: clusterThresholds
inputs.description: Point-count thresholds between color tiers.

inputs.name: pointColor
inputs.description: Color of unclustered points.

inputs.name: zoomOnClusterClick
inputs.description: Zooms into a cluster when it is clicked.

outputs.name: pointClick
outputs.description: Emits { feature, coordinates } when an unclustered point is clicked.

outputs.name: clusterClick
outputs.description: Emits { clusterId, coordinates, pointCount } when a cluster is clicked.

sections.title: MapHeatmap
sections.description:
Renders GeoJSON points as a MapLibre heatmap layer with a theme-aware default gradient. Generic over the feature properties: MapHeatmapComponent

, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: GeoJSON points (object or URL string).

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id prefix for the source and layer: heatmap-source-<id>, heatmap-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates them.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: weightProperty
inputs.description: Numeric feature property used as the point weight. Without it every point weighs the same.

inputs.name: weightRange
inputs.description: [min, max] of weightProperty, mapped linearly to a weight of 0..1.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Influence radius of each point in pixels. Accepts MapLibre expressions.

inputs.name: intensity
inputs.description: Global intensity multiplier. Accepts MapLibre expressions.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Layer opacity. Accepts MapLibre expressions.

inputs.name: gradient
inputs.description: Color stops [density 0..1, color]. Sorted, with a transparent stop at 0 prepended when missing. Defaults to defaultHeatmapGradients for the resolved theme.

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Minimum zoom at which the heatmap is rendered.

inputs.name: maxZoom
inputs.description: Zoom from which the heatmap is no longer rendered (e.g. to hand over to a point layer).

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: heatmap paint properties merged last.

sections.title: MapSymbolLayer
sections.description:
Icons and text labels for GeoJSON points as a MapLibre symbol layer (collision-aware). Images are registered from a URL or decoded pixels, shared by id between layers and survive theme switches; SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer. Generic over the feature properties: MapSymbolLayerComponent

, with P inferred from data. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: GeoJSON points (object or URL string).

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Optional stable id prefix for the source and layer: symbol-source-<id>, symbol-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates them.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Images to register by id, referenced from icon. A MapSymbolImage is a URL (PNG, WebP or JPEG), { url, sdf?, pixelRatio? } or { data, sdf?, pixelRatio? } with decoded pixels. URLs are decoded once and re-added after a theme switch. Ids are shared per map: layers registering the same id use one image (the first to add it provides the pixels, so give different images different ids), removed when the last layer using it goes away; an id the style already has is never removed. SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer; use one layer per kind.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Image id, or an expression resolving to one (["get", "kind"]).

inputs.name: iconSize
inputs.description: Icon scale.

inputs.name: iconColor
inputs.description: Icon color. Only applies to SDF images ({ url, sdf: true }). SDF and non-SDF images cannot be mixed in one layer; use one layer per kind.

inputs.name: textField
inputs.description: Label text: a {property} template, a plain string or an expression. Needs the style glyphs; ignored (with a console warning) on the blank style.

inputs.name: textFont
inputs.description: Font stack for the labels. Defaults to the basemap's own, which its glyph server serves.

inputs.name: textSize
inputs.description: Label size in pixels.

inputs.name: textColor
inputs.description: Label color (#171717 light, #fafafa dark).

inputs.name: textHaloColor
inputs.description: Label halo color (#ffffff light, #0a0a0a dark).

inputs.name: textHaloWidth
inputs.description: Label halo width in pixels.

inputs.name: textAnchor
inputs.description: Which part of the label touches the anchor.

inputs.name: textOffset
inputs.description: Label offset in ems.

inputs.name: allowOverlap
inputs.description: Draw icons and labels even when they collide (sets icon-allow-overlap and text-allow-overlap).

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Minimum zoom at which the layer is rendered.

inputs.name: maxZoom
inputs.description: Zoom from which the layer is no longer rendered.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: MapLibre filter expression, reconciled live.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Escape hatch: layout properties merged last.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: paint properties merged last.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Whether features respond to mouse events.

outputs.name: featureClick
outputs.description: Emits { feature, longitude, latitude, originalEvent } when a symbol is clicked. Requires interactive.

outputs.name: featureHover
outputs.description: Emits the hovered symbol (again when the pointer moves to another one), and null when the pointer leaves. Requires interactive. Inline data without feature ids gets ids generated from the feature index (generateId); data with ids keeps them.

sections.title: MapRasterSource
sections.description: Raster tile source (XYZ, TMS, WMS) plus the raster layer that draws it. Source and layer are re-added after a theme switch. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: MapLibre source id, used verbatim (other components reference it as source: id). The layer is raster-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates both.

inputs.name: tiles
inputs.description: Tile URL templates ({z}/{x}/{y}, {bbox-epsg-3857} for WMS). Updated in place with setTiles.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: TileJSON URL, instead of tiles (takes precedence). Updated in place with setUrl.

inputs.name: tileSize
inputs.description: Tile size in pixels. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: minzoom
inputs.description: Minimum tile zoom. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: maxzoom
inputs.description: Maximum tile zoom. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: attribution
inputs.description: Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: [west, south, east, north] limit of the tiles. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: scheme
inputs.description: Tile addressing scheme. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Raster layer opacity (raster-opacity).

inputs.name: visible
inputs.description: Whether the layer is drawn; the source stays loaded when hidden.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: raster paint properties merged last.

sections.title: MapVectorSource
sections.description: Vector tile source (MVT, TileJSON or pmtiles://). Adds the source only: draw it with layers that reference it by id and wait for it with MapContextService.hasSource(id). ng-mapcn does not depend on pmtiles; register the protocol yourself with maplibregl.addProtocol. When torn down or the style reloads it removes every layer still using the source, then the source: gate your layers on hasSource(id). tiles vs url mode is fixed at creation. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: MapLibre source id, used verbatim; layers reference it as source: id. Announced through MapContextService.hasSource(id) while it exists. Changing it re-creates the source.

inputs.name: tiles
inputs.description: Tile URL templates. Updated in place with setTiles.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: TileJSON URL or pmtiles://<archive url> (register the pmtiles protocol first), instead of tiles. Updated in place with setUrl.

inputs.name: minzoom
inputs.description: Minimum tile zoom. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: maxzoom
inputs.description: Maximum tile zoom. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: attribution
inputs.description: Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: [west, south, east, north] limit of the tiles. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: scheme
inputs.description: Tile addressing scheme. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: promoteId
inputs.description: Feature property (or per source-layer map) used as the feature id, which enables feature-state on vector tiles. Applied at creation.

sections.title: MapImageOverlay
sections.description: Georeferenced image pinned to four corner coordinates, drawn as a raster layer. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: MapLibre image source id, used verbatim. The layer is image-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates both.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Image URL. Changing it calls updateImage on the live source.

inputs.name: coordinates
inputs.description: Four [lng, lat] corners, clockwise from the top-left. Changing them calls setCoordinates.

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Layer opacity (raster-opacity).

inputs.name: visible
inputs.description: Whether the layer is drawn.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: raster paint properties merged last (e.g. raster-fade-duration: 0 to avoid a flash on url change).

sections.title: MapFillExtrusion
sections.description: 3D extrusion of polygons (fill-extrusion layer), e.g. 3D buildings. Creates only the layer: the source is a basemap source or one added by a source component or the application, and the layer waits for it. Re-added after a theme switch. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Layer id prefix; the layer is fill-extrusion-layer-<id>. Changing it re-creates the layer.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Id of the source to extrude: a tile source component, an application source or a basemap source. Without it, the Carto basemap's building source is used ('protomaps', or 'carto' in the earlier styles). The layer is added once map.getSource(source) exists.

inputs.name: sourceLayer
inputs.description: Layer of a vector source. Omit for GeoJSON sources.

inputs.name: heightProperty
inputs.description: Feature property with the height in meters.

inputs.name: baseProperty
inputs.description: Feature property with the base height in meters.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Fill color; defaults to a theme-aware gray (defaultExtrusionColors).

inputs.name: opacity
inputs.description: Layer opacity, 0..1.

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Minimum zoom at which the extrusion is drawn (the Carto tiles stop at 14).

inputs.name: maxZoom
inputs.description: Zoom from which the extrusion is no longer drawn.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: MapLibre filter, updated with setFilter. null removes the default filter.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the layer before this layer id. Applied at creation only.

inputs.name: paint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: fill-extrusion paint properties merged last.

sections.title: MapTerrain
sections.description: 3D terrain from a raster-dem source (map.setTerrain) with an optional hillshade layer. The terrain is style-level state: it is re-applied after a theme switch and disabled on teardown. One terrain per map. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Id prefix: DEM source terrain-source-<id>, hillshade source terrain-hillshade-source-<id>, hillshade layer terrain-hillshade-<id>. Changing it re-creates all.

inputs.name: tiles
inputs.description: Elevation tile URL templates. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: TileJSON URL, instead of tiles (takes precedence). Applied at creation.

inputs.name: encoding
inputs.description: Encoding of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: tileSize
inputs.description: Tile size in pixels. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: minzoom
inputs.description: Minimum zoom of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: maxzoom
inputs.description: Maximum zoom of the elevation tiles. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: attribution
inputs.default: Mapzen / AWS for the default tiles
inputs.description: Attribution for the map attribution control. Applied at creation.

inputs.name: exaggeration
inputs.description: How tall the terrain looks. Changing it calls setTerrain again.

inputs.name: hillshade
inputs.description: Draw a hillshade layer (with its own DEM source). Added and removed on toggle; the terrain is untouched.

inputs.name: hillshadeExaggeration
inputs.description: Hillshade intensity, 0..1 (MapLibre default 0.5).

inputs.name: hillshadeShadowColor
inputs.description: Hillshade color of the shaded slopes.

inputs.name: hillshadeHighlightColor
inputs.description: Hillshade color of the lit slopes.

inputs.name: hillshadeAccentColor
inputs.description: Hillshade accent color for steep slopes.

inputs.name: hillshadePaint
inputs.description: Escape hatch: hillshade paint properties merged last.

inputs.name: beforeId
inputs.description: Insert the hillshade layer before this layer id. Applied when the layer is created only.

sections.title: MapDraw
sections.description: Draws, selects and edits points, lines and polygons on terra-draw. Lives in the optional ng-mapcn/draw entry point (import { MapDrawComponent } from 'ng-mapcn/draw') and needs the terra-draw and terra-draw-maplibre-gl-adapter peer dependencies. A theme switch (setStyle) stops and restarts terra-draw with the same features and mode. Must be used inside ng-map.

inputs.name: modes
inputs.description: Shapes the user can draw. Changing it restarts terra-draw with the same features and drops an unfinished shape.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Active tool (two-way with [(mode)]). A mode that is not enabled falls back to 'static'.

inputs.name: features
inputs.description: Drawn features as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Point, LineString and Polygon (two-way with [(features)]). Updates when a draw, edit or delete completes. Assigning a collection diffs by feature id; features keep their own ids (any non-empty string or finite number) and those without one get an id; unsupported geometries are dropped and reported through mapError.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Enables the select mode: select, drag, reshape and delete features. Changing it restarts terra-draw and drops an unfinished shape.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Accent color of the drawn shapes (#rrggbb). Defaults to a theme-aware blue. Changing it restyles the modes in place (no restart).

outputs.name: drawEnd
outputs.description: Emits { feature, mode, action } when a new shape is completed.

outputs.name: featureEdit
outputs.description: Emits { feature, mode, action } when an existing feature is moved, reshaped or otherwise edited.

outputs.name: featureSelect
outputs.description: Emits the selected Feature (select mode).

outputs.name: featureDeselect
outputs.description: Emits the id of the deselected feature.

testing.title: ng-mapcn/testing/maplibre
testing.description: Runner-neutral fake of the maplibre-gl module, for unit tests only. It has no imports (it never imports ng-mapcn or a test runner), so it works with any runner that can swap an ES module: Vitest (vi.mock('maplibre-gl', () => import('ng-mapcn/testing/maplibre'))) and Jest (moduleNameMapper '^maplibre-gl$'; documented, not tested by ng-mapcn). Karma/Jasmine are not supported. The fake records every call, fires events on demand and attaches markers, popups and controls to the map container DOM. Stable API: fakeRegistry, the getters and the test-only helpers (fire, listenerCount, finishStyleLoad, ...). The raw calls log is for debugging: its strings may change in any release.

exports.name: Map
exports.description: Fake of maplibre-gl Map. Getters (getLayer, getSource, getCenter, getZoom, getLayerOrder, hasImage, getTerrain, ...), spied methods (jumpTo, setStyle, setData, ...) and test-only helpers: fire(event, payload?, layerId?), listenerCount(event, layerId?), setMoving(value), hasPendingStyle(), finishStyleLoad(), finishStyleLoadWithoutChanges(), failStyleLoad(error?). calls is an unstable debugging log.

exports.name: Marker
exports.description: Fake of maplibre-gl Marker. Its element is attached to the map container. Like MapLibre, a click or Enter/Space on the element toggles its popup, and remove() closes the open popup (firing its close event).

exports.name: Popup
exports.description: Fake of maplibre-gl Popup. Its element is attached to the map container while open. Like MapLibre, a map click (fire('click'), fireMapEvent(map, 'click')) closes it unless it was created with closeOnClick: false (default true; ng-map-popup keeps the default, ng-marker-popup defaults to false). A spec that fires map clicks with a popup open binds [closeOnClick]="false".

exports.name: Point
exports.description: Fake of maplibre-gl Point (x, y, Point.convert()).

exports.name: getWorkerUrl / setWorkerUrl
exports.description: Fake of the global worker URL. Starts as an empty string, like the real one.

exports.name: addProtocol / removeProtocol
exports.description: Fake of the protocol registry. Registered protocols are listed in fakeRegistry.protocols.

exports.name: fakeRegistry
exports.type: { maps, markers, popups, protocols, workerUrl, constructError, deferImageLoads, imageLoads, reset() }
exports.description: Every map, marker and popup created since the last reset(). Call fakeRegistry.reset() in beforeEach. Stable API.

exports.name: FakeMap / FakeMarker / FakePopup
exports.description: Types of the fake Map, Marker and Popup instances.

exports.name: configureFakeMapLibre
exports.description: Call once in the test setup. spy wraps the fake's spied methods: Vitest passes vi.fn, Jest passes jest.fn. Defaults to the identity, so the fake runs without a runner. Applies to instances created after the call; fakeRegistry.reset() does not undo it.

testing.title: ng-mapcn/testing
testing.description: Helpers that render a template with <ng-map> and drive the fake from ng-mapcn/testing/maplibre, which the test setup must install in place of maplibre-gl. Never import it from application code. It needs no @angular/cdk. Stable API: these functions, fakeRegistry, the fake's getters and structuralCalls(). The fake's raw calls strings are not stable: assert through structuralCalls() or the getters. Change host values after rendering through update() or signals passed in hostProps: in zoneless apps (the Angular default; test setups without zone.js) assigning fixture.componentInstance.x directly needs fixture.changeDetectorRef.markForCheck(), as in any zoneless Angular test. Call renderMap() once per test (a second call throws 'TestBed already instantiated'); put several maps in one template.

exports.name: renderMap
exports.description: Renders template in a standalone host that imports MapComponent, then runs change detection until the map exists. Options: imports, providers (environment providers such as provideZonelessChangeDetection() too), hostProps (assigned before the first change detection) and size (default 400x300, null for zero). Returns { fixture, map, ctx }. Once per test. The map is not loaded yet: call loadMap(). Patches the layout getters: call resetMapTesting() in afterEach.

exports.name: loadMap
exports.description: Fires load and styledata, waits out the 100 ms style debounce (with configureMapTesting({ advanceTimers }) or a real timer), then runs change detection so layer components add their sources and layers. Throws a clear error when fake timers are installed without advanceTimers, instead of hanging.

exports.name: reloadStyle
exports.description: Simulates the style requested by setStyle (a theme or styles change) arriving: every source and layer is dropped, style.load and styledata fire, then the components re-add everything. Without a pending setStyle it only fires styledata. Throws like loadMap() on fake timers without advanceTimers.

exports.name: update
exports.description: Assigns host properties, marks the host for check and runs change detection, so it works with and without zone.js.

exports.name: getFakeMap
exports.description: The fake map of the first <ng-map>. Throws if it has not created its map (zero container size or an error).

exports.name: fireMapEvent
exports.description: Fires a map event, like MapLibre would. With a layer id it reaches handlers registered with map.on(event, layerId, handler). Run change detection afterwards if the handlers update the view.

exports.name: structuralCalls
exports.description: The source and layer operations recorded on the map, in order, as 'addSource:<id>', 'addLayer:<id>', 'removeLayer:<id>' and 'removeSource:<id>'. Stable format.

exports.name: setMapSize
exports.description: Sets the container size the map sees (jsdom has no layout). renderMap() patches offsetWidth and offsetHeight to read it live, so it can change after rendering. null means zero size.

exports.name: configureMapTesting
exports.description: advanceTimers advances the runner fake clock by ms; loadMap() and reloadStyle() use it to wait out the style debounce. Vitest: (ms) => vi.advanceTimersByTime(ms). Set it only while fake timers are installed and reset it to null afterwards. Without it the helpers wait on a real timer, and throw if fake timers are installed: @sinonjs/fake-timers (Vitest, Jest) by its tag, any other library because setTimeout is no longer the one in place when ng-mapcn/testing was imported (zone.js patching does not count), confirmed with a 0 ms probe so a spy or wrapper that still runs on real time is not reported. Without zone.js, an untagged library installed before the import cannot be detected.

exports.name: resetMapTesting
exports.description: Restores the HTMLElement offset getters and clears fakeRegistry. Call it in afterEach.

exports.name: MAP_TEST_SELECTORS
exports.type: { map, loader, marker, popup, popupCard, tooltip, popupClose, controls, controlGroup }
exports.description: The stable DOM contract of a rendered map, as CSS selectors: 'ng-map', '.ng-map-loader', '.maplibregl-marker', '.maplibregl-popup' (an open popup or tooltip), '.ng-popup-card' (the role=dialog card), '.ng-tooltip-pill', '.ng-popup-close', '.ng-controls', '.ng-control-group'. The same with the fake and the real MapLibre (the repository's e2e suite checks it in Chromium), so reuse it in Playwright or Cypress tests. The harnesses are built on it. It lives here, not in ng-mapcn/testing/harness, so it needs no @angular/cdk. A selector changes only in a major release. Type of its keys: MapTestSelector.

testing.title: ng-mapcn/testing/harness
testing.description: Angular CDK component harnesses for <ng-map>, its markers, popups and controls. They read and drive the DOM only and run in a TestBed on top of the fake; the repository's e2e suite checks the same DOM contract (MAP_TEST_SELECTORS from ng-mapcn/testing, which they use, and the marker ARIA state) against real MapLibre in Chromium. This is a separate entry point because it imports @angular/cdk/testing, an optional peer dependency of ng-mapcn: install @angular/cdk to use it. Every harness has a static with(filters) predicate. NgMapControlsHarness uses CSS :has(). Button labels are translatable, so NgMapControlsHarness finds its buttons by structure, not by aria-label.

exports.name: NgMapHarness
exports.description: isLoading() (loader overlay shown), getMarkers(filter?), getPopups(filter?), getControls(filter?). Markers, popups and controls are rendered inside the map container, so they are found from here.

exports.name: NgMapMarkerHarness
exports.description: getText(), getAriaLabel(), click(), hover(), mouseAway(), focus(), pressEnter(), hasPopup(), isPopupOpen(). Filters: { text, label }. hasPopup() is true when the marker has an ng-marker-popup (aria-haspopup); isPopupOpen() when this marker's own popup is open (aria-expanded), whatever other popups are open. For a marker whose content has its own button or link (no aria-expanded on the marker), isPopupOpen() reads the aria-expanded of the first such control, which the app mirrors with [attr.aria-expanded]="info.isOpen()" (<ng-marker-popup #info>); it throws when that control has none: use NgMapHarness.getPopups().

exports.name: NgMapPopupHarness
exports.description: getText(), isTooltip(), hasCloseButton(), close() (throws without a close button), pressEscape() (throws for a tooltip). Filter: { text }. A closed popup is not in the DOM, so it is not found.

exports.name: NgMapControlsHarness
exports.description: zoomIn(), zoomOut(), resetNorth(), locate(), isLocating(), toggleFullscreen(), isFullscreen(). Each action throws when its button is hidden (showZoom, showCompass, showLocate, showFullscreen).
